shortDescription: Manage NTP servers on F5OS based systems

options.name: iburst
options.description: Specifies to enable iburst for the NTP service. Specify false to disable it.

options.name: key_id
options.description: Specifies the key ID which identifies the key used for authentication.

options.name: ntp_authentication
options.description: Specifies to enable NTP Authentication if passed True. Specify false to disable it.

options.name: ntp_service
options.description: Specifies to enable NTP service if passed True. Specify false to disable it.

options.name: prefer
options.description: Specifies that this server should be the preferred one if true. Specify false if not.

options.name: server
options.description: Specifies the address of the NTP server. It can be either an IPv4 or IPv6 or an FQDN.

options.name: state
options.description: The NTP server state. If C(present), creates the specified NTP server if it does not exist, or updates the existing one. If C(absent), deletes the NTP server if it exists.
